core.name: Core Engineering Foundation
core.description: Every gate-critical skill: orchestration, autonomous SDLC, brainstorming and plan gates, design gate, humanizer, task contracts and board, shared memory, commit gate, review, QA, security review, browser testing, deployment checks, observability, and local telemetry.

nextjs.name: Next.js & Modern Web Stack
nextjs.description: Next.js App Router, React Server Components, React performance and composition, view transitions, Vercel deploy and optimization, Supabase and Postgres, shadcn/ui, and UI craft.

laravel.name: Laravel Specialist Stack
laravel.description: PHP 8.2+, Eloquent, Sanctum, Livewire, Pest/PHPUnit TDD, verification loop, security hardening, and general backend guidelines.

python.name: Python Backend Stack (Django & FastAPI)
python.description: Backend architecture guidance for Django and FastAPI projects. Note: backend-dev-guidelines is written for Node.js/Express; its layering, validation, error-handling, and testing doctrine applies to Python, but its code samples are TypeScript. No Python-specific skill ships yet; use the stacks skill's Django and FastAPI standards for language detail.

mobile.name: Mobile & React Native Stack
mobile.description: React Native, Expo, mobile performance, gestures, native transitions, and UI craft.

agentic.name: Agent Development & Automation
agentic.description: Agent and skill authoring, skill discovery and benchmarking, interface design exploration, requirement grilling, and browser automation. Google ADK skills moved to the google-adk pack.

creative.name: Creative & Design Assets
creative.description: UI craft, image creation and AI image prompting (including website design reference images), content strategy, and writing guidelines.

design-data.name: UI/UX Design Data
design-data.description: Optional searchable design database: styles, color palettes, font pairings, product types, UX guidelines, and chart types across 10 stacks. Requires Python 3 for its search scripts.

codex.name: OpenAI Codex Image Generation
codex.description: Optional Codex-specific raster image generation and editing. Uses the Codex built-in image tool; the bundled scripts/image_gen.py fallback needs OPENAI_API_KEY in the environment.

google-adk.name: Google Agent Development Kit
google-adk.description: Optional Google agents-cli / ADK workflow and Python API patterns. The upstream scaffold, eval, deploy, publish, and observability sibling skills are not shipped; install them with uvx google-agents-cli setup if needed.

growth.name: Growth: SEO, GEO & Content
growth.description: Optional search visibility (traditional SEO and AI answer engines) and content strategy.

web-tools.name: Web Platform Tools
web-tools.description: Optional modern web-platform guidance (HTML, CSS, client-side APIs) and exposing a local service through an ngrok tunnel.

maintainer.name: Dev-OS Maintainer
maintainer.description: For developing Dev-OS itself: the Telemetry and Eval Engineer agents, the /eval and /telemetry commands, the eval harness, and workflow metrics. Agents and commands resolve from .agents/maintainer/. Not needed in application projects.
